basis_legend.rubric: The app's original JPJ demerit rubric (the v1 simulator's score store, src/stores/carStore.ts, removed in WP6)
basis_legend.guides: Unofficial Malaysian driving-school notes and learner accounts, listed in RULES.md. No official JPJ marking sheet was available.
basis_legend.decided: A simulator choice made on 14 Oct 2026 with no instructor available; the reason is in the note

verdict.pass: All eight stations cleared, in order, with fewer than 20 demerits
verdict.basis: rubric (MAX_DEMERIT 20) + decided (every station must be cleared) + decided 15 Oct (reaching 20 makes the verdict a fail, but the run carries on so the learner rehearses every station, as a failed station does)

pole.basis: rubric; guides: touching a pole fails the element

rollback.rule: Backward travel along a slope of more than 0.30 m while not in reverse, measured from the furthest-forward point since the car last stopped

kerb.basis: decided: guides list touching a kerb or line as a minor fault worth 2-5 points; 5 matches the rubric's minor weight
kerb.rule: A tyre's contact patch over a kerb. One contact counts once; it ends when no tyre has touched that kerb for 0.5 s. Body overhang over a kerb is not a fault

stall.basis: rubric; unreachable with the automatic gearbox

centre_line.basis: the owner, 20 Oct: crossing or touching a centre line is an automatic fail, and the test ends there
centre_line.rule: A tyre's contact patch touching the white line between the two lanes of a two-way road (unbroken, JKR ATJ 2D/85 4.1.2.2). The test ends at once with a fail

collision.basis: decided 20 Oct, with the owner's traffic: a real test stops at a collision; the same weight as a pole
collision.rule: The car's body touching another car's. One contact counts once. The test ends at once with a fail

red_light.basis: decided 20 Oct, with the owner's traffic lights: running a red light ends a real test
red_light.rule: The front bumper crossing a signal's stop line, in its direction, while its light is red (amber is not marked). The test ends at once with a fail

station_outcomes.cleared: Did the thing the station is named after, within its rules
station_outcomes.failed: Any of: time limit passed; the car passed the station's end on the route without clearing it; a station-specific failure below. A failed station fails the run, and the run carries on to the next station so the learner rehearses the rest

motion.basis: decided 15 Oct: the car counts as stopped below 0.5 km/h (0.14 m/s), well under the 5 km/h creep and above sensor noise

timing.starts: When the car reaches the station's s_from on the route
timing.basis: guides (lp-services KPP notes: hill 3 min, side parking 5 min, three-point turn 3 min, S 3 min, Z 3 min, ramp 5 min)

hill-start.clear: Stop with both front tyres' contact points inside the yellow stop band; hold with the handbrake on and the car moving no more than still_m for hold_s; then move off and cross the crest gate without a rollback
fail: crossed the crest gate without a valid stop (passed the band)
hill-start.basis: guides (stop with the front tyre on the yellow line; handbrake on; 3 minutes) + rubric (rollback over 30 cm) + decided (2 s hold, 5 cm stillness)

side-parking.commit: The car is stopped with the handbrake on for commit_s anywhere in the station: that is the learner saying done
side-parking.clear: At commitment, the footprint including the mirrors (1.847 m wide for the Swift) is inside the painted bay and the heading error is within the bay's limit (L sin t + W cos t <= bay width). Then drive out past the station's end
side-parking.outside_at_commit: not_in_bay (10); the station still counts as done
side-parking.basis: rubric (not in bay 10, pole 20) + guides (the right mirror must be inside the box; a pole touch fails) + decided (handbrake as the done signal)

parallel-parking.clear: As side parking, in the painted 6.6 x 2.5 m box inside the kerbed recess
parallel-parking.outside_at_commit: not_in_bay (10); the station still counts as done
parallel-parking.basis: rubric + guides + decided (time limit as side parking)

s-curve.clear: Gates passed in order with the speed held between speed_band_kmh
fail: more than grace_s outside the speed band (assessment); practice mode voids and restarts instead

z-curve.clear: Gates passed in order; a corner gate only counts at or under corner_kmh (too fast does not fail: that gate waits until the car slows)

ramp-test.clear: Drive up onto the platform and stop with the front bumper between stop_window_m short of the pole; hold still (still_m) for hold_s; then reverse down and out past the mouth gate without touching the pole
fail: stopped only outside stop_window_m and drove on (ramp.window: the verdict shows the measured gap against the window)
ramp-test.basis: guides (a DA learner: climb onto the cement block, do not hit the pole in the middle; 5 minutes) + decided (stop window, hold, reverse out)

road-merging.clear: Join the main road's traffic from the slip road, giving way to it, and cross the finish gate at min_kmh or faster
fail: crossed the finish gate below min_kmh (assessment); practice mode lets the learner retry
crossed the give-way line with a main-road car less than the merge's gap_s (circuit.json traffic.merge, 3 s) from the conflict point, or in it (merge.noYield)
road-merging.basis: prd + the owner, 20 Oct (a vehicle joins from a slip road into moving traffic and gives way to it) + decided (a 3 s gap)

assessment.tips: shown for 6 s when a station arms

practice.restart: teleports to the station's start pose

modes.basis: decided: the car has an interior mirror and both door mirrors, as in the real test. On a phone they are small and the driver cannot move their head, and from the driver's eye the bay lines never enter the windscreen view (v1 measured it). So the top-down view stays available in both modes; in assessment the verdict reports how long it was used, with no penalty
